body: **Finding from `worker-36` (#36), for this issue:** `template/.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/task.md` has no Delivery section, and line 35 says to delete "Out of scope" when it is empty. A task written straight from the template therefore fails `lint-issue`'s `delivery` rule, and sometimes `out-of-scope`. This will be the first thing `issue-ready` reports. Needs a planner or template decision: the templat

**Finding from `reviewer-36-r2` (#36), a design constraint for this workflow:** `lint-issue` looks up every "Depends on" reference with `gh`, using the runner's token, and the report is posted publicly. If the workflow's token can read private repositories, the comment becomes a way to learn whether `org/private#n` exists and whether it is open. Keep the token scoped to the repository, or limit lo
